source.description: Project TIFF parser entry that parses the attacker-controlled TIFF/IIQ byte buffer into decoder metadata.
source.value_from: The attacker-controlled raw image buffer enters the project TIFF parser.; value `data`; from `TiffRootIFDOwner TiffParser::parse(const Buffer& data) {`

sink.description: ASan container-overflow read when prepare() accesses segments[i + 1] after the vector was shortened.

root_cause.description: prepare() removes the temporary final segment before the backward coefficient loop still needs segments[i + 1].

tainted_value_origin.description: Attacker-controlled IIQ multiplier metadata is read from ByteStream and used as spline control-point y coordinates.

coarse_trace.summary: Invokes the rawspeed TIFF parser on the attacker-controlled buffer.
Locates Phase One correction metadata and passes its substream to multiplier correction.
Builds spline control points from attacker-controlled multiplier metadata.
Drops the temporary last segment too early and then reads segments[i+1] past the vector logical end.

fine_trace.note: Project parser source: the PoC byte buffer is parsed as TIFF/IIQ input, and the resulting IFD metadata is consumed by IiqDecoder.
Attacker-controlled metadata entries select the Phase One quadrant multiplier block.
The selected metadata substream is passed to the quadrant multiplier correction routine.
The attacker-controlled substream supplies spline control-point y coordinates.
The control points are handed to Spline construction.
The segment vector is sized to include one temporary final segment used during coefficient calculation.
The vulnerable code drops the temporary final segment before the following backward loop still reads segments[i + 1]. The patch moves this pop_back after the loop.
On the final loop iteration, i + 1 names the segment that was already popped.
ASan reports an 8-byte container-overflow READ when this expression reads the popped segment.
